visual.general_description: Color photograph of a lower leg and heel on a blue surgical drape with ink lines drawn on the skin.
visual.detailed_description: A leg is shown from the side with the calf at the left of the image and the heel at the right. A leaf-shaped closed outline is drawn in dark blue ink on the calf. A straight red line and a blue line run from the calf toward the ankle and meet near a small outlined mark close to the heel, which carries a red dot and the handwritten text "5cm" below it. Faint thin ink lines are also visible on the skin above the calf outline. The heel skin looks dry with yellowish scaling and fine cracks. A hand holds the foot at the right edge and the background is a blue drape. No incision or suture is visible.

visual.general_description: Color intraoperative photograph of a leg with a raised oval skin flap and a long open incision on blue surgical drapes.
visual.detailed_description: A gloved, blood-stained hand holds metal forceps that lift the proximal end of an oval to teardrop-shaped skin paddle whose incised edges show yellow-pink fat and red tissue. A narrow strip of skin continues from the paddle toward the ankle along the upper edge of a long open incision that exposes dark red muscle. Near the ankle at the right, faint purple ink lines, a circle and the handwritten text "5cm" remain on intact skin. Blood stains mark the blue drape in the lower part of the image.

visual.general_description: Color intraoperative photograph of a raised foot and leg showing a skin flap sutured at the heel and a long suture line along the leg.
visual.detailed_description: The foot is raised and extends upward out of the frame, with the heel at the left. A rounded pale skin island is sutured into the heel region with closely spaced interrupted stitches of blue and red thread. A long suture line with many close stitches runs from the flap along the side of the leg toward the lower right of the image and ends at an elongated diamond-shaped darker area crossed by stitches, with a small stitched notch at its end. Faint purple ink lines are visible on the skin. A gloved blood-stained hand is partly visible at the top and blue drapes cover the left and lower parts of the image.

Small reddish-brown specks are present on the skin near the lesion, and the skin at the lower right of the image is dry with white flaking. The background at the right is blue, with a dark object at the upper right.

visual.general_description: Color photograph of the sole of a foot on a green surgical drape with a patch of skin and thin scar lines at the heel.
visual.detailed_description: The plantar surface of a foot is shown with the toes toward the top on a green drape. The heel is covered by a patch of skin whose texture and color differ from the surrounding sole. A thin dark-red line runs across the upper edge of the heel, another thin line runs along its lower edge, and a curved linear scar extends toward the left and ends in a small raised pink area. The toes and forefoot skin show mild peeling. No sutures are visible.
